set -eu

import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

cele, ggal, ncra, scer, archive = sys.argv[1:6]
work = pathlib.Path.cwd()
db_root = work / "busco_downloads"
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
    zf.extractall(db_root)

lineages = [p for p in db_root.rglob("eukaryota_odb10") if p.is_dir() and (p / "dataset.cfg").exists()]
if len(lineages) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one eukaryota_odb10 lineage, found {len(lineages)}")
lineage = lineages[0]

slots = max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))
samples = [
    ("Animals_Cele", cele),
    ("Animals_Ggal", ggal),
    ("Fungi_Ncra", ncra),
    ("Fungi_Scer", scer),
]
out_root = work / "busco_runs"
single_copy = {}
for label, fasta in samples:
    run_name = "run_" + label
    cmd = [
        "busco", "--in", fasta, "--out", run_name, "--out_path", str(out_root),
        "--mode", "proteins", "--lineage_dataset", str(lineage),
        "--offline", "--cpu", str(slots), "--force",
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    tables = list((out_root / run_name).rglob("full_table.tsv"))
    if len(tables) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one BUSCO full table for {label}, found {len(tables)}")
    ids = set()
    with tables[0].open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            if not line.strip() or line.startswith("#"):
                continue
            fields = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[1] == "Complete":
                ids.add(fields[0])
    single_copy[label] = ids

shared = set.intersection(*(single_copy[label] for label, _ in samples))
version = subprocess.run(["busco", "--version"], check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
version_text = (version.stdout or version.stderr).strip().replace("\t", " ")
with open("shared_single_copy_buscos.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write(f"# busco_version\t{version_text}\n")
    out.write("# mode\tproteins\n")
    out.write("# lineage\teukaryota_odb10\n")
    for label, _ in samples:
        out.write(f"# single_copy_count_{label}\t{len(single_copy[label])}\n")
    out.write(f"# shared_single_copy_count\t{len(shared)}\n")
    out.write("BUSCO_ID\n")
    for busco_id in sorted(shared):
        out.write(busco_id + "\n")
PY
